objective: Propagate a Gaussian random field of eddy-viscosity log discrepancy through the periodic hill and answer the only question that decides whether the band is worth anything: does the two sigma band contain the truth on a case the statistics were not fitted on
rationale: The third step of Dow's method is propagation, and it is the step where his own work returns a negative result he discloses himself. On a straight channel, with the statistics fitted at one friction Reynolds number and applied unchanged at two higher ones, he reports the reference profile mostly inside the two sigma band. On two-dimensional random geometries the same machinery fails in the unsafe direction: his own words are that the reference profiles typically fall outside the intervals and that the estimated level of uncertainty is too low, which he attributes to a flat one parameter scaling of the field magnitude against the strain rate norm. Neither artifact prints a coverage number anywhere, so there is no published fraction to inherit and any number the lab quotes has to be its own. That is the gap this item fills, and it fills it on a case where the cost is measured rather than guessed: the earlier ensemble study propagated forty members through this same case and billed 135.47 core-min at the lower dispersion, a median member of 3.23 core-min, and it left behind an ensemble builder, a field injection path and a null test that recovered the baseline reattachment to one part in ten thousand. The truth for this case is a published large eddy simulation reattachment, and the same study already placed two other bands against it, so a third band arrives with two predecessors to be compared against rather than into an empty column. One rule from that study is adopted unchanged and pre-registered here rather than rediscovered: residual gating discarded exactly the members nearest the truth, the twelve gated members averaging 5.556 in reattachment against a truth near 4.6 to 4.7 while the twenty-eight kept members averaged 6.695, so the ungated ensemble is what gets reported. The case is a benchmark training family and no scored test case is opened.
gate: Pre-registered before any member runs. G1 coverage is reported as a fraction with its denominator: the number of comparison stations at which the reference lies inside the two sigma interval, over the number of stations, with the stations named in advance. G2 the band width is reported beside the coverage, because a band that contains the truth by being wide is a different object from one that contains it by being right, and the existing deterministic union on this case is the width it is measured against. G3 the ensemble is reported ungated; a gated subset may appear beside it and never instead of it, with the discarded count stated. G4 the statistics are fitted on a case other than this one and that case is named before the fit, so the test is held out by construction and not by narration. A band that fails to contain the truth is reported as the headline, in the same words as a band that succeeds
cost_basis: measured: forty members through this case at this mesh billed 135.47 core-min with a median member of 3.23 core-min in the earlier ensemble study, plus a baseline and a null member at the same per-member price. The sampler, the injection path and the aggregation are arithmetic at no solver cost. The estimate carries no allowance for oversubscription, and the earlier pre-registration measured four ranks on two cpus billing 8.0 core-min against 6.1 for the same solve, which is the way this number goes wrong
expected_knowledge_gain: Four distinguishable outcomes. A band that contains the truth at a stated coverage and is no wider than the deterministic union it replaces is the first probabilistic band this lab can defend, and it makes the uncertainty layer a product surface. A band that contains the truth only by being much wider repeats what the random matrix study already measured, and says the fitted magnitude carries no information the two point union did not. A band that misses the truth reproduces the source method's own two-dimensional failure on a different geometry with a different solver, which is a publishable confirmation that the failure is in the method rather than in his implementation. A band that misses in the safe direction, too wide and off centre, indicts the transfer of statistics between cases rather than the sampling, and sends the next item back to the fitting step
